subject: Insurance
title: The Suspicious Fire Patterns
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Suspicious Fire Patterns.

hook.text: Accelerant-sniffing dogs can detect gasoline at concentrations as low as one part per billion.

buildup.text: Arson investigators look for V-patterns on walls, multiple points of origin, and pour patterns on floors.

discovery.text: Modern gas chromatography identifies the exact accelerant used.

twist.text: Some wrongful convictions used now-debunked arson science.

climax.text: Arson science has advanced enormously, but false positives still haunt the field.

punchline.text: Dogs detect one part per billion.

quiz.question: What can accelerant-sniffing dogs detect?
options: Accelerants at concentrations as low as one part per billion
